notes.title: HOTFIX 2.0.45
notes.content:
Patch Notes Version 2.0.45

[h2]🛠 Player Settings Changes for Linux/Windows/SteamDeck Platforms[/h2]

[h2]🏷 Major Changes:[/h2]
- **[b]Unreal Engine 5 Global Illumination (Lumen):[/b]** Disabled for all players using Low/Medium graphic quality. This change aims to improve performance and compatibility on systems with more modest hardware.

[h2]🐧 Additional Instructions for Linux/SteamDeck Platforms:[/h2]
If you still encounter issues running the game on a Linux/SteamDeck platform, you may need to manually edit the `GameUserSettings.ini` file before running the game again. Follow the steps below:

1. Go to the folder `[i]~/.config/Epic/TRAUMA[/i]`.
2. Look for the file `[i]GameUserSettings.ini[/i]` inside the folder `[i]Saved/Config/Linux[/i]`.
3. Change the lines to the following values:

[ScalabilityGroups]
sg.ResolutionQuality=100
sg.ViewDistanceQuality=0
sg.AntiAliasingQuality=0
sg.ShadowQuality=0
sg.GlobalIlluminationQuality=0
sg.ReflectionQuality=0
sg.PostProcessQuality=0
sg.TextureQuality=0
sg.EffectsQuality=0
sg.FoliageQuality=0
sg.ShadingQuality=0

[h2]📝 Important Notes:[/h2]
- These manual changes will only be necessary if the game does not launch correctly after the update.
- The update will adjust these settings by default only for new players.
- If you already have the game installed, you will need to make these changes manually or reinstall the game, removing the old settings to allow the game to create the new ones by default.
- When removing the old settings, do so with the game running, even if it crashes. Only remove the files in the folder containing `[i]GameUserSettings.ini[/i]`. [b]Do not remove the `[i]SavedGames[/i]` folder to avoid losing your saved progress.[/b]

Thank you for your understanding, and we hope these changes improve your gaming experience!

tags.balance_change: - **Unreal Engine 5 Global Illumination (Lumen):** Disabled for all players using Low/Medium graphic quality. This change aims to improve performance and compatibility on systems with more modest hardware.

notes.title: UPDATE 2.0 - PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
[h1]2.0 - Patch Notes:[/h1]


[h2]General Changes:[/h2]
- [b]Lock-on Screen Mouse by Default:[/b] Mouse control is now locked on the screen by default, enhancing player control and experience.
- [b]Rework Color Grading:[/b] All visuals are now displayed in full color, enriching the overall aesthetic of the game.
- [b]Rework Lights:[/b] Implemented an enhanced indirect lighting system to improve visual quality and realism.
- [b]Rework Flashlight:[/b] Both player and scenario flashlights have been revamped for better illumination and atmosphere.
- [b]Rebalanced Difficulty:[/b] Made adjustments to enemy behaviors and game mechanics across all difficulty levels for a more balanced experience.

[h2]Control Enhancements:[/h2]
- [b]Reworked Directional 2D System Control:[/b] Automatic switching between 2D and Tank controls based on input method (analog for 2D, keyboard or gamepad D-pad for Tank).
- [b]Improvements in Flashlight:[/b] Increased exposure while flashlight is active for better visibility.
- [b]Sophia gets Wet in Rain:[/b] Implemented a dynamic weather system where Sophia reacts realistically to rain.

[h2]User Interface and Settings:[/h2]
- [b]Additional Graphic Options:[/b] Expanded graphic options available in the main menu settings for customization.
- [b]Reworked Tutorial Screen:[/b] Improved tutorial interface for better player guidance.
- [b]Universal Menu:[/b] Merged pause menu and main menu into a single, streamlined interface.
- [b]Closet Feature:[/b] Added a closet function accessible from both the main menu and pause menu (Universal Menu).

[h2]Visual and Audio Enhancements:[/h2]
- [b]Reworked Brightness System:[/b] Overhauled brightness system for improved visual clarity.
- [b]Optimizations:[/b] Optimized sports outfit, maid outfit and schoolgirl attire for better performance.
- [b]Controller Vibration Option:[/b] Added the ability to enable/disable controller vibration.
- [b]Auto-change Input System:[/b] Implemented a system to automatically switch between keyboard/mouse and gamepad inputs.

[h2]Gameplay and Animation:[/h2]
- [b]Boss Rework:[/b] The first boss now follows you during battle and we added some shelves so you can dodge her attacks. Overhall damage taken from/time to defeat was decreased in all difficulties for all Bosses.
- [b]Enemy Behavior Changes:[/b] Some enemies will no longer follow the player's visual changes, introducing new gameplay dynamics.
- [b]Updated Animation:[/b] Enhanced animation for walking backwards, improving character movement fluidity.
- [b]Complete Body Jiggle Physics:[/b] Implemented more jiggle physics for character animations, enhancing realism and immersion. (also applied to enemies) For the science, you know.


These changes aim to enhance player immersion, control, and overall gameplay experience in the game. We hope you enjoy Patch 2.0!

tags.balance_change: - Rebalanced Difficulty: Made adjustments to enemy behaviors and game mechanics across all difficulty levels for a more balanced experience.
- Improvements in Flashlight: Increased exposure while flashlight is active for better visibility.
Overhall damage taken from/time to defeat was decreased in all difficulties for all Bosses.

tags.feature: - Added a closet function accessible from both the main menu and pause menu (Universal Menu).
- Controller Vibration Option: Added the ability to enable/disable controller vibration.
- Auto-change Input System: Implemented a system to automatically switch between keyboard/mouse and gamepad inputs.
- Complete Body Jiggle Physics: Implemented more jiggle physics for character animations, enhancing realism and immersion. (also applied to enemies) For the science, you know.

notes.title: A True Retro-Classic Survival Horror!
notes.content:
[b]TRAUMA Broken Paradise is a Survival Horror Psychological Thriller created on Unreal Engine 5.[/b]

[i]- This game have Seven Endings and Eleven Outfits for you to Unlock by just finishing the game with specific actions.
- This is NOT a Jumpscare Horror Game. If you got jumpscared it's not intentional.[/i]

TRAUMA Broken Paradise is a new experience at the same time, an old one.
You're trapped inside an old mansion and need to solve riddles and puzzles in order to discover why you are there and why all this is happening?

Also inspired by one of Stephen's King's greatest works: "The Shining".
You can find secrets and everything happens in a unique way.

[i]- Fixed Camera Angles and Third Person
- First Person in Combat while using the Camera.
- Over The Shoulder camera in one of the Endings.
- Easy combat but hard riddles and puzzles.
- Inventory Notes, Photos that indicates Objectives also on inventory.
- A map that indicates all the doors that open with each key once you have them in your inventory.
- Endings based in different choices you make.
- The game itself is a riddle. Very hard for some people and very easy for others.
- MAP is available so you won't get lost and you can find some hints if you explore.
- At least 6 hours of gameplay for new players and 12+ if you complete every achievement.
- Inventory with 8 slots and an Universal Item Box so you can store your items when your inventory's full.
- Some situations will require the player to take attention and observe the environment in order to proceed and they can be intentionally confusing sometimes.
- Enemies are completely random which makes the replay factor more interesting.
- Secrets are all over the place... you can find them while using the Camera, some of them are just... unexpected.[/i]

To make unlocking multiple endings more dynamic, the gameplay is basically short once you learn where to go.
This game was made with love! I'm a huge fan from the classics and true Survival Horror games. I did my best!

[b]This game contains situations of extreme psychological horror and may cause mental disorders to certain players.

Also, the plot involves topics that some people may have a sensitivity to, such as sexual assault/non-consensual sex, legal drug abuse and suicide.[/b]

notes.title: EASY MODE AND OPTIMIZATIONS
notes.content:
[b]Hello Survivor![/b]

[b]I HAVE SOME GOOD NEWS FOR YOU![/b]

I'm very happy to announce that this last week we did a lot of improvements in the game following your feedback:

[i]- Added new easier modes for new players.
- Added more hints on MAP as locked doors location with a redmark and showing the key door location on map when you have the key in your inventory just like the Classic ones that we are used to.
- Balanced all the game mode difficulty systems to bring a better experience for those who enjoy challenges and those who enjoy story and puzzles.
- Reworked Lighting system to bring even more performance. The game runs well in almost every computer.[/i]

[b]And more will come soon![/b]

[i]Thank you so much for your feedback and I hope you enjoy the news![/i]

[b]Have fun![/b]
